title: Chinese Face Solo #06 (중국 · 아이돌 · 눈물 글썽한 · 메이크업 구풍(포인트) · 피어싱 P3 · 스티커 금박 별(관자놀이) · 렌즈 핫핑크(하트 동공) · 각도 고개 살짝 기울임 · 점 눈물점+입술점)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, her head tilted a little to one side, her eyes looking straight into the camera, both ears clearly visible, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Early 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Chinese woman — Chinese pop idol visual luminous milky ivory-fair complexion with a cool-neutral undertone and smooth dewy skin, early 20s, hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum, long straight black hair with soft see-through bangs. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, a soft sheen of natural oils, large eyes with bright real catchlights, full lips, a small dark beauty mark just below the outer corner of her left eye like a tear mole, a second tiny beauty mark above the right corner of her upper lip, each one a clearly visible dot of real skin pigment, slender upswept willow-leaf brows, a fine red floral huadian mark painted on the forehead, softly flushed rosy cheeks, an upswept eyeliner tail, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a small vivid red lip, vivid hot-pink coloured contact lenses with a heart-shaped pupil, both eyes the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, four small gold foil star stickers, two at each temple, all stickers flat on the skin, clear of the eyes and lids and clear of the piercings, glistening eyes brimming with unshed tears, a pleading upward gaze at the camera, lips trembling slightly, a teary-eyed, vulnerable, pleading expression — a photograph of a real Chinese woman's face (East Asian Chinese features: a longer oval face with prominent high cheekbones and a defined jawline, long upturned phoenix-shaped eyes with sharp inner folds, a high strong nose bridge, thin arched eyebrows with a slight rise, balanced lips), not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light 

Piercings: A thick polished rose-gold segment ring on each ear and one small rose-gold stud above the left one. Each piece carries small amethysts set into the metal. All jewelry is real rose gold, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
